meta.kind: slot starts per interval at sampled instants
meta.generator: slot_starts.py (Python zoneinfo, json and the pinned tzdata package, no Fuse code)
meta.tzdata_policy: a row is kept only when the pinned and system sources give the same starts
rule: dayStart(D, Z) is the earliest instant whose local calendar date in zone Z is D. This matches Temporal's ZonedDateTime.prototype.startOfDay(). When midnight falls in a gap, it is the transition instant. When midnight repeats, it is its first occurrence.
Day slots start at dayStart(D). An ISO week starts at dayStart of its Monday. A month starts at dayStart of its first day, and a year at dayStart of 1 January.

Second, minute, quarter-hour and hour slots step a fixed duration len of 1 s, 60 s, 900 s or 3600 s from dayStart(D). The start is dayStart(D) + floor((t - dayStart(D)) / len) * len. When a day's length is not a multiple of len, its last slot ends early at dayStart(D + 1).
D is the local date of t in every case. A day slot, an ISO week, a month and a year contain t, and the self-checks confirm that dayStart(D) <= t < dayStart(D + 1).
meta.row: [t_ms, start_second_ms, start_minute_ms, start_quarter_ms, start_hour_ms, start_day_ms, start_week_ms, start_month_ms, start_year_ms]
meta.samples: For each UTC-offset transition T, T plus each of [-61, -31, -1, 0, 1, 29, 31, 61] minutes; dayStart of the local dates of T - 1 s and T and of the day after each, each minus 1 s, exactly and plus 1 s; and the first instant within an hour of T whose wall time is HH:45 in T's local hour. Fixed-offset zones use the dayStart of each fixed_offset_days entry as T.

cut.reason: the full sample set exceeds 200000 bytes
cut.selection: Every row whose t is a transition instant T is kept. Of the other rows of a zone, in time order and counted from 0, row i is kept when floor((i + 1) * 42 / 100) > floor(i * 42 / 100). That keeps 42 percent of them, spread evenly.
